department: Department of Mathematics, School of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences

deadline.value: School of Graduate Studies sets April 1 as the Fall application deadline for international F-1 degree-seeking applicants (unless an earlier program deadline applies); Morgan's Application Deadlines portal lists May 1, 2027 for Industrial and Computational Mathematics, PhD (Fall 2027), and SGS funding applications are due April 30.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines for the School of Graduate Studies (SGS) are as follows (unless earlier deadline dates are indicated by the individual programs): ... International, degree-seeking (All F-1 in and out of USA) Fall - April 1

also.quote: Mathematics PhD Saturday, May 1, 2027 Fall 2027 Graduate Industrial and Computational Mathematics, PhD

gre_subject.value: The catalog entry for Industrial and Computational Mathematics does not mention the GRE Mathematics Subject Test.

supervisor.value: Admitted students choose a specialization and dissertation advisor in consultation with ICM graduate faculty; no pre-admission advisor commitment is stated.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships (TA/RA, $21,000 doctoral stipend plus tuition award up to 9 credits/semester excluding university fees) and fellowships require a separate School of Graduate Studies funding application (due April 30 for Fall) and are not guaranteed.
funding.quote: SUBMISSION OF A FUNDING APPLICATION DOES NOT MEAN YOU WILL BE APPROVED. The decisions will be based on program selection and availability of funding per each program. | Graduate assistantships for doctoral and master's degree students pay a stipend ($21,000-doctoral $12,000-master's) Tuition awards do not pay for university and miscellaneous fees.

entry_route.value: Option I requires 36 academic credit hours beyond a master's degree; Option II requires 60 academic credit hours for candidates with a baccalaureate degree.
entry_route.quote: Candidates for the Doctor of Philosophy degree must complete: a minimum of 36 academic credit hours for candidates who already possess the master’s degree (OPTION I) and a minimum of 60 academic credits for candidates only possess the baccalaureate degree (OPTION II)

notes: Graduate catalog specifies 36 credits post-master's or 60 credits post-bachelor's (the grad.morgan.edu marketing summary lists 39 credits). Spring admission deadline is December 1.
name: Industrial and Computational Mathematics
